label: Diagram 4.1
caption: Diagram 4.1 | Barrier siting
description: This is a side elevation line drawing titled "Diagram 4.1 Barrier siting". In the upper left corner the text reads "See para 4.1". The drawing shows a simple outline of a vehicle, drawn from the side with two circular wheels, resting on a pale grey horizontal band that runs across the lower part of the image, its left edge at the barrier. To the left of the vehicle's front end stands a short vertical line, labelled "Vehicle barrier" beneath it, rising from the grey band. From the top of this barrier a zigzag line extends horizontally to the right, terminating in an open arrowhead that points at the front of the vehicle. A short horizontal dashed line projects to the left from the barrier, level with the top edge of the grey band. The bottom of the image carries a green band with the white text "Diagram 4.1" on the left and "Barrier siting" to its right.
